INSERT INTO runrun_analytics.f_task_events (
    raw_id,
    performer_id,
    event_type,
    happened_at,
    event_date,
    created_at,
    sk_task,
    sk_board
)
SELECT
    te.raw_id,
    te.performer_id,
    te.event_type,
    te.happened_at,
    te.happened_at::date,
    now(),
    dt.sk_task,
    db.sk_board
FROM runrun_staging.task_events te
LEFT JOIN runrun_analytics.dim_tasks dt ON dt.task_id = te.task_id
LEFT JOIN runrun_analytics.dim_boards db ON db.board_id = te.board_id
ON CONFLICT (raw_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO runrun_analytics.dim_users (
    user_id,
    name,
    email,
    position,
    is_manager,
    on_vacation,
    extracted_at
)
SELECT
    payload_json->>'id',
    payload_json->>'name',
    payload_json->>'email',
    payload_json->>'position',
    COALESCE((payload_json->>'is_manager')::boolean, false),
    COALESCE((payload_json->>'on_vacation')::boolean, false),
    extracted_at
FROM runrun_raw.users_a
ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
SET
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    position = EXCLUDED.position,
    is_manager = EXCLUDED.is_manager,
    on_vacation = EXCLUDED.on_vacation,
    extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at
WHERE runrun_analytics.dim_users.extracted_at < EXCLUDED.extracted_at;

INSERT INTO runrun_analytics.dim_boards (
    board_id,
    board_name,
    extracted_at
)
SELECT
    (payload_json->>'id')::bigint,
    payload_json->>'name',
    extracted_at
FROM runrun_raw.boards_a
ON CONFLICT (board_id) DO UPDATE
SET
    board_name = EXCLUDED.board_name,
    extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at
WHERE runrun_analytics.dim_boards.extracted_at < EXCLUDED.extracted_at;

INSERT INTO runrun_analytics.dim_tasks (
    task_id,
    title,
    board_id,
    extracted_at
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (task_id)
    (payload_json->>'id')::bigint AS task_id,
    payload_json->>'title' AS title,
    (payload_json->>'board_id')::bigint AS board_id,
    extracted_at
FROM runrun_raw.tasks_a
ORDER BY task_id, extracted_at DESC
ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE
SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    board_id = EXCLUDED.board_id,
    extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at;

INSERT INTO runrun_analytics.task_current_state (
    task_id,
    performer_id,
    current_status,
    happened_at,
    updated_at,
    title,
    board_name
)
SELECT
    t.task_id,
    t.performer_id,
    t.event_type,
    t.happened_at,
    now(),
    t.title,
    b.board_name
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY task_id
               ORDER BY happened_at DESC, raw_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM runrun_staging.task_events
    WHERE event_type = 'working'
) t
LEFT JOIN runrun_analytics.dim_boards b ON b.board_id = t.board_id
WHERE rn = 1
ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE
SET
    performer_id   = EXCLUDED.performer_id,
    current_status = EXCLUDED.current_status,
    happened_at    = EXCLUDED.happened_at,
    updated_at     = now(),
    title          = EXCLUDED.title,
    board_name     = EXCLUDED.board_name;
